title: MAPF — obstacle density
description: Sixteen agents on 20x20 grids, obstacle density from 5% to 30%, five seeds. Same solvers as the scaling suite. The generator guarantees every start and goal lies in one connected region, so a failure here is a solver failure and never an unreachable goal.
machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11850H @ 2.50GHz (16 logical CPUs), Linux 6.8.0-136-generic (x86_64), Python 3.10.12, harness 0.1.0@1c81f77e6938. Installed: jupyddl 2.3.0, matplotlib 3.10.9, numpy 2.2.6, openplan-bench 0.1.0, pymapf 0.8.0.
